annotations.title: Value of UF, UVA, UVR, UDI or UI

description: Return the official value of a Latin American inflation-indexed unit (UF Chile, UVA Argentina, UVR Colombia, UDI Mexico, UI Uruguay) for today, and optionally convert an amount of units to local currency. Use it for contracts, rents and loans expressed in these units. For UF on a past date or pesos to UF, cl_uf is more complete. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /latam/indexacion via x402.

fecha.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; supported for UF (past dates, or future dates up to the 9th of next month) and UI (since 2002-06-01, published up to the 5th of next month). Default today.

monto.description: Number of units to convert to local currency.

unidad.description: Unit: uf, uva, uvr, udi or ui.
